title: The Silence of the Girls
author: Pat Barker
summary: The Trojan War is retold from the viewpoint of Briseis, a queen captured when Achilles' army sacks her city. She becomes a spoil of war in the Greek camp and sees the heroes at close range.
readIf: you like myth retellings that give women's experiences of war a central place.
skipIf: you are sensitive to depictions of sexual violence or want heroic adventure.
